title: A single pass does not reach 0.20 Bq/cm2
trigger_or_cause: At assumed K = 24 per second per Bq/cm2 and about four background counts per second, D# is 0.408 (uncompensated, uniform field) and 0.510 (compensated, matched reference) at 0.1 uSv/h for a 1 s pass; K itself depends on the undefined measurand.
consequence: The moving-sensitivity target RQ-022 is not met in one pass; false-flag allowance at the mission level raises D# further (0.902 at alpha 1.14e-5).
proposed_control: Survey methods of DEC-038 (search then count, step and count, continuous scan at about 0.025 m/s); more sensitive reference tile or pooled references; site to define K basis, patch size and alpha.
residual_risk_evidence_needed: Measured K and background on the head (K_beta measurement, report section 8) and a site decision on patch size and probabilities.
current_mitigation_0_4: Calculated only; mission-time estimates for the three methods in the architecture document.

title: Alpha channel not viable for scanning at 10 mm standoff
trigger_or_cause: 0.20 Bq/cm2 gives about 1.20 counts per second in the alpha channel (assumed K_alpha = 6), below the three counts needed for 95 % detection with zero background; response changes by tens of per cent for 2 mm of gap or a 35 K change of air temperature.
consequence: Alpha results cannot be produced while moving; stationary alpha needs controlled standoff.
proposed_control: Report alpha only from stationary dwell of at least 10 s with a measured standoff (RQ-066).
residual_risk_evidence_needed: Alpha response versus standoff and temperature (VT-044).
current_mitigation_0_4: Calculated range model; no measurement.
